title: comastoma dechyanum
intro: Comastoma dechyanum, commonly known as the Chinese comastoma, is a flowering plant species in the gentian family (Gentianaceae). It is used in traditional medicine to promote health and well-being, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include exhibiting immunomodulatory and anti-tumor activities, making it a potential agent in cancer treatment and immune system regulation. The bioactive constituents of Comastoma dechyanum include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
